Of 100 simulated battles (level 50, standard sets), Lugia wins 100 and Ho-Oh 0.

WHY IT PLAYS OUT THIS WAY

Lugia is faster than Ho-Oh (130 vs. 110 Speed) and moves first.

Best answer of Lugia: Extrasensory deals 16.6–19.9% of Ho-Oh's HP per hit.

Best answer of Ho-Oh: Extrasensory deals 6.1–7.7% of Lugia's HP per hit.

Q&A

Lugia. At level 50 Lugia reaches 130 Speed, Ho-Oh only 110 — so Lugia moved first in every simulated battle.

Rarely. Of 100 simulated battles (level 50, standard sets), Lugia wins 100 and Ho-Oh only 0. Custom moves or items can change the picture — try it in the simulator above.
